answer: Shards are assigned from the voyage graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The thread assignment is published and walnut records each panel. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1092 identities would post 4220 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
